7257.title: Plugin selector ancestor filtering
7257.rootCauseOneLine: Multi-alternative ancestor scopes prevent Chromium from collecting a required attribute, making nonmatching plugin utility rules expensive on host elements.
7257.proposedFix: Split complete generated utility rules by root alternative when serving assets, preserving named-only and anonymous roots and existing owned-root negotiation.
7257.caveats: Reproduced isolated compiler-generated CSS overhead in two clean checkouts. macOS Electron thread-switch and sidebar timings were not measured; the proposed marker-required rewrite breaks an existing toast root.
